projectContext.name: Full-Stack Engineering Template
projectContext.description: Monorepo with React admin, TanStack Start SSR, Flutter, React Native, Go API, Python Auth, Rust Data service

postgresql.purpose: Full-stack apps (React, Go, Python, Rust, Mobile)

tables.users: UUID PK, email, phone, password_hash, full_name, avatar_url, role, email_verified, is_active, last_login_at, timestamps
tables.user_roles: BIGSERIAL PK, user_id FK, role, granted_by FK
tables.user_sessions: UUID PK, user_id FK, token_hash, device_info JSONB, ip_address INET, expires_at
tables.categories: UUID PK, parent_id self-FK, name, slug, description, image_url, sort_order, is_active
tables.products: UUID PK, category_id FK, name, slug, sku, barcode, description, cost_price, selling_price, compare_price, stock, min_stock, unit, weight, images JSONB, features JSONB, is_featured, is_active, deleted_at
tables.product_images: UUID PK, product_id FK, image_url, alt_text, sort_order, is_primary
tables.orders: UUID PK, order_number, user_id FK, status, payment_status, payment_method, subtotal, discount, tax_percent, tax_amount, shipping_fee, grand_total, currency, shipping_address JSONB, billing_address JSONB, notes, paid_at, shipped_at, delivered_at, deleted_at
tables.order_items: UUID PK, order_id FK, product_id FK, product_name, quantity, unit_price, subtotal
tables.cart_items: UUID PK, user_id FK, session_id, product_id FK, quantity
tables.quotations: UUID PK, quotation_number, user_id FK, ref_no, date, expiry_date, subtotal, discount, tax_percent, grand_total, status, notes
tables.quotation_items: UUID PK, quotation_id FK, product_id FK, product_name, quantity, unit, unit_price, amount
tables.quotation_history: BIGSERIAL PK, quotation_id FK, action, old_status, new_status, performed_by FK, notes
tables.inquiry_messages: BIGSERIAL PK, inquiry_id FK, sender_id FK, message, is_read
tables.favorites: BIGSERIAL PK, user_id FK, product_id FK, UNIQUE(user_id, product_id)
tables.expenses: UUID PK, category_id FK, user_id FK, expense_date, amount, description, receipt_url
tables.notifications: BIGSERIAL PK, user_id FK, type, title, message, data JSONB, is_read, read_at
tables.audit_logs: BIGSERIAL PK, user_id FK, action, target_table, target_id, old_values JSONB, new_values JSONB, ip_address INET, user_agent
tables.system_settings: BIGSERIAL PK, setting_key UNIQUE, setting_value JSONB, description, updated_by FK
tables.banners: UUID PK, title, subtitle, image_url, link, sort_order, is_active, start_date, end_date
tables.promotions: UUID PK, title, description, image_url, link, discount_type, discount_value, min_purchase, max_uses, current_uses, is_active, start_date, end_date

projects.land-houses-dev: Real estate, UUID PKs, JSON columns, i18n (la/en/zh), 10 tables
projects.thiengtham-dev: POS + E-commerce, INT PKs, 20+ tables, dual-mode admin/storefront
projects.rent-miss-clean-dev: Rental POS, INT PKs, 11 tables, rental workflow
projects.phonhong-dev: Legacy CodeIgniter POS, 80+ tables, no FKs
projects.viengchalern-dev: Legacy CodeIgniter POS, 80+ tables, no FKs
projects.buddhaword: Buddhist scripture search, MySQL + 13 SQLite databases
